spec.description:
This API endpoint is used to generate a link token which will be valid for 6 months.. This token can be utilized for Health Information Provider (HIP) Initiated Linking, enabling HIPs to securely link patient health records to their ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) address. The generated token ensures that the linking process is authenticated and authorized, maintaining the integrity and security of health information exchange. This functionality is crucial for facilitating seamless and efficient linking of health records within the healthcare ecosystem.
  1. Authorization: We are passing the access-token in the authorization [Example: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCIgOiAiSldUIiwia2lkIiA6ICJBbFJiNVd]

parameters.description: Suffix of the consent manager to which the request was intended
parameters.name: X-CM-ID

parameters.description: Identifier of the health information provider to which the request was intended

schema.description: In the request body, either 'abhaNumber' or 'abhaAddress' must be included, with atleast one being mandatory based on the patient profile.

abhaAddress.description: abhaAddress of the user/patient. Allows alpha numeric character and special characters like ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.]+[a-zA-Z0-9]@(abdm|sbx)$

abhaNumber.description: it can be null if abhaNumber is not linked with abhaAddress. Allows numeric character like ^\d{14}$

gender.description: Allows M, F, O, D, T, U as a input

name.description: Only alphabets and special characters like ',.- are allowed like ^[a-zA-Z]+(([',. -][a-zA-Z ])?[a-zA-Z]*)*$

yearOfBirth.description: Year of birth must be 4 digit, ranging between 1900 and 2200

spec.summary: API used to generate link token to link the health records

reply.Text:
## Link Record Token Generation

The **POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token** endpoint generates a link token for HIP-initiated linking. This token allows Health Information Providers (HIPs) to securely link patient health records to their ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) address, and is valid for 6 months.

### Request Details

**Headers (required):**
- `Authorization`: Bearer access-token
- `REQUEST-ID`: Unique UUID to track the request (e.g., `18235d89-cb13-479d-ad71-7a57d5f669a8`)
- `TIMESTAMP`: ISO 8601 format (e.g., `2022-10-06T15:10:00.587Z`)
- `X-CM-ID`: Consent manager suffix (e.g., `sbx`)
- `X-HIP-ID`: HIP identifier (e.g., `IN2810014366`)

**Request Body** (application/json):
- `abhaAddress`: ABHA address (alphanumeric + special chars: ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.]+[a-zA-Z0-9]@(abdm|sbx)$) — **required** (or abhaNumber)
- `abhaNumber`: 14-digit ABHA number (nullable if not linked with address)
- `name`: Patient name (alphabets and special chars: ',.- only)
- `gender`: M, F, O, D, T, or U
- `yearOfBirth`: 4-digit year (1900–2200)

### Response

**202 Accepted** — Token generated successfully

**Error Codes:**
- `400` — Bad request (e.g., invalid HIP ID)
- `401` — Unauthorized (invalid credentials)
- `403` — Access denied
- `404` — Resource not found
- `500` — Authentication failure
- `503` — Dependent service unavailable (ABDM-1024)

See the [link token generation endpoint](https://abdm-developer.nha.gov.in/docs/hiecm/v3/api/m2/endpoints/m2-post-v3-token-generate-token) on the ABDM developer portal for complete details.
